principle: Utility links are optional post-discovery helpers. They do not affect which place/camera ERN ranks or recommends.

opportunities.placementRule: Only in Before You Go / travel-planning context, never in camera ranking.
opportunities.why: Broad usefulness across international ERN destinations; low maintenance.

opportunities.placementRule: Show only for city/transport-hub destinations where luggage storage is plausibly useful.
opportunities.why: Strong utility for arrival/departure windows and day-trip visitors.

opportunities.placementRule: Only where Go City actually supports the destination; do not show globally.
opportunities.why: Distinct city-pass option that complements, rather than duplicates, attraction links.

opportunities.placementRule: Use as fallback/coverage expansion where Welcome Pickups lacks useful service.
opportunities.why: Extends airport/city transfer coverage without opening another network.

opportunities.placementRule: Only after a visitor enters trip-planning context; never on Watch Earth cards.
opportunities.why: Global flight-search utility can support the See Live → Decide → Go journey.

opportunities.placementRule: Use only in road-trip/island trip-planning contexts after owner-side destination coverage is confirmed; suppress competing rental brands by default.
opportunities.why: Potentially strong visitor utility in Georgia, Montenegro, island/coastal destinations and other self-drive contexts.

opportunities.placementRule: Only where exact self-guided audio-tour inventory exists and the action adds something distinct from city passes/full tours.
opportunities.why: Low-friction cultural utility for visitors already exploring a city through ERN.

opportunities.placementRule: Use only where exact bike/scooter/motorcycle inventory is useful; never auto-place globally.
opportunities.why: Adds a different local-mobility layer in destinations where a bicycle or scooter is a natural way to explore.

opportunities.placementRule: Never show during normal Earth discovery. Only surface in a clearly relevant flight-disruption/help context after exact partner access is verified.
opportunities.why: Potentially useful after a real travel disruption, but unrelated to destination ranking.

opportunities.placementRule: Optional planning utility only; never fear-based, never presented as required, and never shown on live-view ranking surfaces.
opportunities.why: May fill a later trip-protection gap if owner terms and exact link are acceptable.

opportunities.placementRule: Reserve for airports/cities/resorts not well served by Welcome Pickups, Kiwitaxi or intui.travel; suppress duplicates.
opportunities.why: Potential fallback transfer coverage without changing the primary transfer choice.

opportunities.placementRule: Reserve alternative only when the preferred rental partner lacks useful destination coverage; never stack multiple car-rental buttons.
opportunities.why: Broadens owner-side fallback coverage without changing the one-rental-option rule.

opportunities.placementRule: Reserve for destinations where Localrent/QEEQ/AutoEurope do not provide a useful exact option; suppress duplicates.
opportunities.why: Adds a differentiated fallback in road-trip markets while preserving visitor simplicity.

opportunities.placementRule: Connectivity fallback only; normally show one eSIM provider, never several competing options.
opportunities.why: Provides a second global connectivity path if the chosen primary lacks country coverage or terms become unsuitable.

opportunities.placementRule: Only after an actual/relevant flight disruption and only if AirHelp is unavailable or unsuitable; never surface during normal destination discovery.
opportunities.why: Maintains a recovery fallback without creating normal-travel commercial clutter.

opportunities.placementRule: Research/coverage alternative only; one eSIM option should be shown by default after owner coverage comparison.
opportunities.why: Owner account exposes link generation and the program may outperform the primary on some countries; selection remains utility-first.

opportunities.placementRule: Use only for a differentiated coverage case; do not stack with other eSIM programs.
opportunities.why: Potential specialized connectivity coverage for destinations where the primary eSIM option is weak.

opportunities.placementRule: Keep as research reserve; never show alongside another eSIM by default.
opportunities.why: Adds a final owner-available connectivity fallback without affecting Earth discovery.

opportunities.placementRule: Only after Earth discovery and only if the Earthrightnow Project has Booking.com access. Prefer one destination/property deep link; never auto-place lodging on camera cards.
opportunities.why: Travelpayouts publicly lists Booking.com in accommodations; lodging is ERN's largest remaining business-category gap.

opportunities.placementRule: Use only for a clearly distinct visitor need after owner-project access and exact deep-link support are confirmed; do not replace better specialist partners just for consolidation.
opportunities.why: Official Travelpayouts 2026 documentation shows Trip.com spanning hotels, flights, trains, attractions, experiences, transfers and car rental.

opportunities.placementRule: Use only in explicit Get There / Move There contexts with exact route or destination relevance; never on live-camera cards.
opportunities.why: 12Go can fill ferry/rail/bus gaps that tours and flight partners do not solve.

opportunities.placementRule: Use only where owner access exists and inventory materially improves on existing Viator/Klook/KKday/Tiqets options.
opportunities.why: Travelpayouts publicly lists GetYourGuide; it can serve as a selective activity fallback rather than another default button.

opportunities.placementRule: Only if current Earthrightnow project access exists and destination coverage is stronger than the selected existing rental option; never stack multiple car-rental buttons.
opportunities.why: Potential broad coverage complement for airports, islands and road-trip destinations.

opportunities.placementRule: Research-only until current program availability is confirmed owner-side. If available, use only where it wins a utility comparison against Localrent/QEEQ/AutoEurope/etc.
opportunities.why: Could expand rental coverage while keeping ERN's one-useful-rental-option rule.

opportunities.placementRule: Only in Get There / Move There after Zanzibar is chosen and only if exact current ferry/route inventory is supported by the Earthrightnow Project.
opportunities.why: Zanzibar is a natural ferry/intercity-transport use case that tours, flights and airport transfers do not fully solve.

opportunities.placementRule: Post-discovery stay utility only; one accommodation action per destination cluster after owner-project availability and exact deep-link support are verified.
opportunities.why: The new island coverage creates a high-intent stay-planning use case and accommodation remains ERN's largest business-category gap.
